props.doc: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.
props.name: name

props.doc: Whether the switch is initially active. To render a controlled switch, use the `checked` prop instead.
props.name: defaultChecked

props.doc: Whether the switch is currently active. To render an uncontrolled switch, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.
props.name: checked

props.doc: Event handler called when the switch is activated or deactivated.
props.name: onCheckedChange

props.doc: The value submitted with the form when the switch is on. By default, switch submits the "on" value, matching native checkbox behavior.
props.name: value

props.doc: Identifies the form that owns the hidden input. Useful when the switch is rendered outside the form.
props.name: form

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: The value submitted with the form when the switch is off. By default, unchecked switches do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.
props.name: uncheckedValue

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

props.doc: Whether the user should be unable to activate or deactivate the switch.
props.name: readOnly

props.doc: Whether the user must activate the switch before submitting a form.
props.name: required

props.doc: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.
props.name: inputRef

props.doc: The id of the hidden input element. When `nativeButton` is `true`, the id is applied to the root element.
props.name: id

switch.Thumb.summary: The movable part of the switch that indicates whether the switch is on or off.
